answer: Reputation-weighted escrow routing. Each new agent’s first ten transactions must post a full refundable deposit plus a slow-release performance bond, and inbound requests route through the highest-reputation harbor that accepts liability for defaults. A clone therefore needs a genuine track record to reach the marble of trusted routing, and forged history collapses to its nadir once linked accounts share failure exposure. The marginal clone costs more in locked capital and forgone throughput than any achievable gain.
